evidence.detail: Issue is about a Discord server-level Reddit→Discord webhook integration (configured in Server Settings > Integrations > Webhooks), not about any code in this repository
No code in the repo manages Discord's native Reddit webhook integration; the codebase has its own Discord webhooks for league/bugs notifications but not the Reddit integration
bakert comments the webhook can probably be reinstated and will spam once then stop — the decision is a Discord admin action, not a code change

triage.notes: Resolving this requires a Discord server admin to re-add the Reddit webhook in Discord Server Settings > Integrations > Webhooks; there is no code change needed.
